comment: Reviewed allowlist (F1): the twilightforest: ids that TF's imported data names but that are not data files, each with its kind, the reason and the TF source that registers it. tools/import (Known.cs) resolves every twilightforest: reference of the imported data against the generated data files, the BP definitions, owners.tsv and this list; a reference found nowhere fails the import. 'tfDangling' lists references that are dangling in TF itself (kept verbatim for parity, reported as a warning on every run). An entry no data references any more is reported as stale. Edit by hand only, with the TF source that registers the id.
